core_principles.text: Keep the heel of the front leg on the ground at all times when lunging.

common_mistakes.text: Allowing the heel of the front leg to lift off the ground during the lunge.

specific_findings.text: The lunge trials were performed to a marked distance equaling exactly 75% of the subject's dominant leg length.

consequences.text: Allowing the front heel to lift off the ground during a lunge causes excessive patellofemoral stress.

source: data\lunge\Evaluation of automatic identification of events during the lunge exercise using kinematic data.pdf [part 2/5]
